note: Turnhout had NO town wall: an open town grown round the castle of the dukes of Brabant and the church, with gates (barriers) between the houses giving onto the fields (inventory 300598). The ring here is only the edge of the built-up town on the Ferraris map; the 'gates' are the road exits, named by destination, not historical gates.
source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Turnhout' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/300598)
